name: cal-com-booking
description: Cal.com inline embed plus a Convex webhook mirror. React uses @calcom/embed-react; explicit SvelteKit uses native Svelte 5 over the shared vanilla embed loader.

env.name: CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env.description: Server-only shared value used to verify Cal.com webhook signatures.

notes: The bundled Convex feature only verifies and mirrors webhook events into bookings. list/cancel/reschedule agent tools are host-injected adapters and require separate authorized Cal API bindings.
